tools.binding: use the canonical app_contract backend_roles binding for this exact tool
tools.policy: mutates_remote_state; real trusted gateway confirmation required

request_contract.topic: svf.pubsub.<32 lowercase UUID hex>; persist room-to-topic identity
request_contract.message_id: fresh canonical UUID; retry identical message with SAME message_id/topic/bytes
request_contract.message: 1..4096 UTF8 bytes; a canonical JSON envelope with message_id, fresh nonce and actual user text is suitable, preserve exact sent bytes
request_contract.forbidden: api_url,peer/daemon controls,argv,path,validator,unknown scope; never bypass consent

response_contract.unwrap: Native payload may be under result/result/content[0].json; inspect actual endpoint response shape, reject every error/isError/false success envelope
response_contract.actual_delivery: accepted=true,durable=false,delivery_state=delivered plus B raw receive and A raw ACK matching exact message_id/topic/message_sha256; HTTP publish ACK or published flag alone is insufficient
response_contract.receiver_frame_base64: Actual Kubo NDJSON; decode canonical base64, then actual multibase data/topicIDs/seqno; sender_peer_id=A,receiver_peer_id=B distinct actual registered nodes
response_contract.ack_frame_base64: Actual B to A acknowledgement on topic+.ack; canonical JSON binds same message_id/topic/message_sha256 and reversed peer IDs
response_contract.replayed: true on identical retry; preserve original actual frames, never duplicate dispatch
response_contract.ui: Show actual decoded received text and concrete peer/delivery state; queued/offline is NOT delivered; preserve input and message identity for governed retry. Reopen metadata is not fresh delivery, obtain real readback/retry before new verification. Details and hashes can be collapsed.
response_contract.scope: Two owned local peers; real stopped-node bridge recovery is not certified by first foundation. Original app offline/recovery acceptance remains required.

scope: Readonly API context; edit only this task's declared app/scenario files. Canonical gateway consent, actual native results, independent receipt+DAG, original semantic workflow, final Grok review and validator remain mandatory. Foundation qualification is not app completion. No caller endpoint/argv/code/path or forged success.
